content:
Apple TV's three-part documentary series about the UConn women's basketball team is now available to stream. Here's a trailer.

《The Dynasty: UConn Huskies》now streaming on Apple TV

Apple TV subscribers can now stream all three episodes of 《The Dynasty: UConn Huskies》, their new sports documentary series.

《The Dynasty: UConn Huskies》features "interviews with coaches, athletes, alumni, rivals and journalists from across UConn's eras" and is directed by Matthew Hamachek (《Tiger》) and Erica Sashin (《Wrong Man》).

Here's how Apple TV describes the series:

《The Dynasty: UConn Huskies》joins Apple TV's growing sports lineup, which also includes 《Ted Lasso》, 《The Dink》, 《Stick》, 《F1 The Movie》, 《Fight for Glory: 2024 World Series》, 《Onside: Major League Soccer》, 《Messi's World Cup: The Rise of a Legend》, and 《Stephen Curry: Underrated》, among others.

Apple TV earlier today also confirmed the return date for 《Stick》, along with the addition of a new cast member who will be familiar to fans of the platform's hit series 《Pluribus》.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month and is also available as part of an Apple One bundle. The platform offers a wide range of popular TV shows and movies, including 《Ted Lasso》, 《Severance》, 《The Studio》, 《The Morning Show》, 《Shrinking》 and 《Silo》.
